in_marathi.name: Dnyanesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dnyanesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dnyanesh is a Sanskrit and Marathi name derived from the Sanskrit words 'dnya' meaning knowledge and 'esh' meaning lord, god or ruler. Dnyanesh is a name for someone who is knowledgeable and wise.
